273: Rabbi Abba began: As in the days of your coming out of the land of Egypt, I will show you wonders (Micah 7:15). The Holy One, blessed be He, has prepared to show the revelation to His children like those days that the Holy One, blessed be He, sent out the Jewish people and showed them the plagues upon Egypt, and struck them on account of the Jewish people. Come and see, what is [the difference] between this redemption and the redemption [from] Egypt? The redemption [from] Egypt was with one king and with one kingdom, here it will be all the kings of the world. And so the Holy One, blessed be He, will be glorified in all of the world, and they will all know that rulership is with the Holy One, blessed be He. And they will all be struck with supernal plagues, two for each one, because they all refused [to set free] the Jewish people.
